title: Every holomorphic function admits a coefficientwise Eichler integral
statement: Let n∈ℕ and h : ℍ → ℂ. Assume z↦h(ofComplex z) is complex differentiable on {z∈ℂ | Im z>0}. Then there exists F : ℍ → BinaryForm ℂ n satisfying IsEichlerIntegral n h F: for every exponent index d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ and every τ∈ℍ, the derivative at τ of z↦coeff d (F(ofComplex z)) is h(τ) times coeff d ((τX+Y)^n).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => h (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → ∃ F : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n h F
